problem: The configurable statistical contract authority port and HTTP method security used different policy sources, so a non-default deployment could authorize the workflow but reject its controller boundary.
scope: Align StatisticalContractController author, approve and import method-security expressions with StatisticalContractAccessDecision. Run the API/core regression suite. No permission vocabulary migration or release claim.
baseline: Current dirty worktree after governance package; pre-existing backend changes preserved.
reuse: Reuses the existing StatisticalContractAccessDecision bean and authorityName port already used by StatisticalReferenceController; removes duplicated controller literals.
impact: HTTP method security now resolves AUTHOR, APPROVE and IMPORT through the configured access-decision policy before the workflow executes. Read access remains the existing platform READ_RESOURCE boundary.
compatibility: Default properties retain WRITE_RESOURCE, PUBLISH_RESOURCE and WRITE_RESOURCE behavior. Custom authority properties now apply consistently at both HTTP and workflow boundaries.
failure: Missing bean or invalid role fails application startup; missing configured authority is denied. No retry or state mutation occurs at method-security evaluation. Revert the controller annotation-only change if compatibility evidence fails.
security: Preserves tenant and execution-time subject checks in StatisticalContractAccessDecision; no broad grant or anonymous path is introduced.
